_comment: Commands the agents run inside the target repo. Copy to config/targets.json and adjust.

coder._comment: Agent Develop delegates code edits to Claude Code in headless mode, limited to the repo. {PROMPT_FILE} is replaced at runtime.
coder.command: claude -p "$(cat {PROMPT_FILE})" --permission-mode acceptEdits --allowedTools Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep,"Bash(npm run *)","Bash(npx vitest *)","Bash(git status)","Bash(git diff *)" --disallowedTools "Bash(git push *)","Bash(git merge *)"
